0022600171.text: The Clippers (1-5, 4th in the Pacific and 13th in the West, on a five-game losing streak) host the Raptors (3-3, 3rd in the Atlantic and 5th in the East, on a two-game losing streak) in the Clippers' seventh game of the season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Clippers swept the 2025-26 series 2-0, most recently beating Toronto 119-94 in Los Angeles on March 25. The Clippers will be without Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Derrick Jones Jr., Jordan Miller, Rui Hachimura, and Yanic Konan Niederhauser, while the Raptors will be without Kawhi Leonard and Nate Bittle, and Jakob Poeltl and Scottie Barnes are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions.
